correctness.rationale: The tangent Chern class and Segre hyperplane class give the five displayed polar degrees by the standard smooth polar transform. The determinantal dual has codimension n-1, so the range ends at index 4. The gcd follows from delta_0-delta_4=n+1 and delta_2=3n^2, plus gcd(n,n+1)=1.

value.rationale: P^2 x P^n is the natural variety of rank-one 3-by-(n+1) matrices. The result gives a complete arithmetic phase law for all five generic nontransversality degrees: a common prime occurs precisely in one residue class, and otherwise the vector is primitive.
